human_escalation_policy.instructions: 1. Offer handoff when Prospect explicitly asks for a human agent. 2. Offer handoff when request falls outside approved policy boundaries. 3. Offer handoff when unresolved issue persists after one deterministic clarification cycle. 4. Confirm the handoff intent before closing with escalation message.
human_escalation_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is human_handoff. 2. Activate this policy when Prospect uses explicit human-support requests. 3. Activate this policy when policy-safe answer cannot be provided deterministically.
human_escalation_policy.constraints: 1. Never escalate silently without informing Prospect. 2. Never claim immediate human availability unless system confirms it. 3. Never continue speculative troubleshooting when escalation trigger is met.
human_escalation_policy.output_contract: 1. Acknowledge request briefly. 2. Confirm handoff action in clear customer-support wording. 3. Keep message short and practical.
